title: Reverence Festival
subtitle: A week of art, wellness and community at Alloha Qi Space.
venue: Alloha Qi Space, Kalyani Nagar, Pune
summary: A week of art, wellness and community: daily Qi Gong, yoga, live music, drum circles and more.
body:
Join us for a week of art, wellness, and community at the Reverence Festival.

Enjoy daily Qi Gong, yoga, live music, drum circles, and more throughout this immersive wellness week.

Our doors are open to all who wish to explore Zhineng Qigong, music, yoga, art, and sculptures in a welcoming and inspiring space.

Come connect, create, and rejuvenate with us.
